fields.title: Inner enclosure emissivity and obstructions
fields.finding: Uniform .20 emissivity and an empty diffuse sphere produce an exact view-factor identity for that geometry; equipment, frames, seams and actual inner finish are absent.
fields.needed: Measure the inner surface and model obstructions/view factors before assigning installed cavity heat exchange.
